name: intentrax
description: Intentrax execution assurance: skills to find consequential agent actions and wire admit -> execute -> verify, plus a read-only MCP server to verify proofs. Never executes, admits, signs, or writes.

settings.name: Intentrax tenant read API key (optional)
settings.description: Only for the intentrax_read_tenant_proof tool. Use a least-privilege, read-only key; leave empty for keyless public verification.

settings.name: Intentrax tenant ID (optional)
settings.description: Tenant whose proofs intentrax_read_tenant_proof may read; leave empty for keyless public verification.
